title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics integration for prompt-quality gating
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds a per-prompt CI hook that computes prompt-level regressions and uploads detailed metrics to the eval metrics service. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We need stronger per-prompt regression protection in CI so model rollouts don't regress narrow but high-impact prompts. This PR adds a new per-prompt CI hook that runs the eval-harness on changed prompt-sets, computes per-prompt metrics (accuracy, BLEU, semantic-similarity, hallucination score), and uploads metrics to the eval-metrics service for historical comparison.

What changed: implemented a new CI hook `scripts/ci/per_prompt_eval_hook.py`, updated GH Actions workflow `ci/eval-per-prompt.yml` to call the hook on prompt-set changes, extended the eval-metrics client with a small bulk-upload endpoint and tagging for prompt-set, and added per-prompt threshold config in `eval-harness/config/prompt_quality.toml`. Adds tests and fixtures for the per-prompt runner.

Testing: added unit tests for the metrics client and the per-prompt runner (tests/eval/test_per_prompt_hook.py). Added an integration CI job that runs a small prompt-set to validate end-to-end upload to the staging eval-metrics service. Ran the full eval-harness test-suite locally and in CI.

Rollout plan: ship gated behind feature flag `per_prompt_ci` in CI config. Rollout to staging for 48h, then enable for beta teams. If the hook reports false positives, ops can silence individual prompts via `eval-harness/overrides/silenced_prompts.json` until thresholds are tuned.

Backward compatibility: The feature is opt-in via CI config; existing workflows remain unchanged until the flag is enabled.

Related work: references ENG-1421 (per-prompt metrics design doc) and ENG-2107 (eval-metrics bulk upload API).
